note: single-machine kind cluster; figures are RELATIVE, not absolute

storage.method: sum of vending.db + vending.db-wal + vending.db-shm (WAL mode -- most recent writes live in the -wal file until a checkpoint), read via an ephemeral busybox debug container sharing the vending-service pod's PID namespace (/proc/1/root), since the production image is distroless with no shell (it holds the lab's highest-privilege credential).
storage.caveat: SQLite WAL-mode file size is NOT linear in row count between checkpoints -- the -wal file grows in fixed page increments and is periodically truncated on checkpoint, so 'bytes per delegation' from one run's before/after delta is a noisy upper-bound estimate of true marginal row cost, not a precise per-row figure. Reported as measured, not smoothed.

network_load_proxy.note: NOT a packet capture. Response body byte counts per stage, as a lower-bound proxy for payload size only -- excludes TLS/HTTP/TCP/IP framing overhead, mTLS handshakes to OPA, the SPIRE Workload API's own gRPC traffic, and kubectl's own transport. Single-node kind uses the loopback/bridge network, not a real multi-host network, so absolute bandwidth numbers would be meaningless anyway.
